objects.account: the user's account with the vendor, as the client knows it
objects.agent_definition: a stored definition of an agent that the client can start; not a running agent
objects.client: the installed client program itself: its version, files and disk use
objects.diagnostics: the client's own checks and usage figures
objects.feature: a named switchable feature of the client
objects.host: the machine the client runs on, outside any session
objects.integration: a tool server or connector configured in the client
objects.memory: what the client keeps across sessions on the user's behalf
objects.message: one item of a session's conversation
objects.model: a model the client can use, and where models come from
objects.plugin: an installable extension of the client, whatever the vendor calls it
objects.policy: what the client may do without asking: permissions, sandbox, approval rules
objects.project: a directory or repository the client knows as a unit of work
objects.queue: messages waiting to enter a session
objects.remote_task: a task that runs in the vendor's own remote service; not a local task
objects.service: a long-running process of the client on this host
objects.session: one conversation of the client, whatever the vendor calls it
objects.setting: a configuration value of the client
objects.skill: a stored instruction set that the client can load into a session
objects.worktree: a working copy that the client creates and manages; not a project

account.limits: the rate limits that apply to the account now
account.status: whether and how the client is signed in

client.disk_usage: what the client's own files use on disk
client.paths: where the client keeps its data, configuration, cache and state
client.store: where the client's session store is
client.version: the version the installed client reports

diagnostics.usage: token and cost figures the client has recorded locally

integration.auth: the authentication state of integrations; never the credentials

model.catalogue: the catalogue of providers and models that can be added
model.provider: a source of models configured in the client

plugin.marketplace: a configured source from which plugins are installed

policy.defaults: the rules the client ships with
policy.requirements: the rules an administrator imposes on the client

service.status: whether the service runs and answers
service.version: the version the running service reports

session.goal: the stated goal of the session
session.loaded: the sessions the service holds in memory now
session.output: the recent terminal output of a background session
session.usage: token and cost figures of the session

setting.effective: the configuration as resolved from every source

actions.check: run the client's own checks and report; changes nothing
actions.export: write the object out in full to the caller; changes nothing
actions.list: name the objects that exist; changes nothing
actions.read: return one object or one aspect of it; changes nothing
actions.search: name the objects that match a query; changes nothing
actions.validate: say whether a stored object is well formed; changes nothing
actions.write: set one object or aspect to the given value; changes state that writing the previous value restores
